answer: Sybil resistance comes from making each identity costly to mint. Require every agent to bond a refundable stake tied to a unique hardware-attested key, a cipher no rival can cheaply clone. Picture each stake as timber pilings driven beneath a jetty: every fake identity needs its own expensive piling, so a flood of sybils sinks under capital cost, not compute. Honest agents reclaim their bond; forgers forfeit it, making mass identity farming economically irrational.
